                 action='store_true', display=PosArgDisplay.OPTIONAL),
            Flag('--target-file', dest='target_file', default=None),
            Flag('--target-format', dest='target_format', default='json'),
            Flag('--spec-file', dest='spec_file', default=None),
            Flag('--spec-format', dest='spec_format', default='python'),
            Flag('--indent', dest='indent', default=2, arg_type=int),
            Flag('--debug', dest='debug', default=False, action='store_true'),
            Flag('--inspect', dest='inspect', default=False, action='store_true'),
            Flag('--scalar', dest='scalar', default=False, action='store_true'),
        ],
        pos_arg_spec=PosArgSpec('spec', 'target', optional=True),
        middleware=[mw_get_target],
    )
